claims.subject: champions_of_amonkhet

evidence.quote: Zahur, Basri, and the rest of the Amonkheti take to the stage bedecked in gold and bright linen.
When they receive the Aetherspark, it is as a team—no one person's hand touches it before any other.

claims.summary: The Amonkheti team receives the Aetherspark as a team at the end of the Grand Prix.

claims.subject: zahur

evidence.quote: Zahur leads the Amonkheti delegation alongside Basri Ket and a crew of living and undead charioteers.

claims.summary: Zahur leads the Amonkheti team, with Basri Ket.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

evidence.quote: Cloudspire's co-captains are Chandra Nalaar and Kolodin, the latter being last year's sole captain.

claims.summary: Chandra Nalaar co-captains Cloudspire with Kolodin.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

evidence.quote: However, Chandra's desire to win the Aetherspark for her lover, Nissa, overrode other loyalties.
Just as she opens her mouth to begin, Nissa kisses her.

claims.summary: Chandra races to win the Aetherspark for her lover Nissa.

evidence.quote: She picks up another samosa, following Pia as the former renegade leads her daughter to the dining room.
Chandra's choice to join Cloudspire over the Aether Rangers sent shockwaves through the Avishkari public, who assumed she would join her mother as co-captain of the home team.

claims.subject: valgavoth

evidence.quote: Winter is a survivor of Duskmourn who has been granted temporary leave by Valgavoth, the archdemon of the plane, to try and win the Aetherspark for reasons, of course, of Valgavoth's own.

claims.summary: Valgavoth lets Winter leave Duskmourn temporarily to try to win the Aetherspark for him.
claims.limitation: The guide says his freedom depends on winning; this links to Valgavoth seizing Winter in DSK.

claims.subject: winter

evidence.quote: Winter and the Speed Demon hold Loot captive and plan to take advantage of his abilities in the race.

claims.summary: Winter and the Speed Demon hold Loot captive.

claims.subject: winter

evidence.quote: Bring us the Aetherspark, and you're free.
If Winter (or a racer on his crew) wins, he might be granted his freedom.

claims.summary: Winter races for the Aetherspark to win his freedom.
claims.limitation: The episode line is dialogue addressed to Winter.

claims.subject: gonti

evidence.quote: Since the Phyrexian invasion and the collapse of the old Consulate in the Indigo Revolution, the Grand Prix has been championed by the new night minister of Ghirapur, Gonti.

claims.summary: Gonti, Ghirapur's night minister, champions and oversees the Grand Prix.
claims.limitation: 'Championed' and 'overseen' rather than run day to day.

claims.subject: mendicant_core

evidence.quote: The Guidelight Voyagers are an uncanny collection of automatons captained by a single mind

claims.summary: Mendicant Core captains the Guidelight Voyagers.

claims.subject: loot

evidence.quote: Loot, for his part, clings to Chandra's shoulders and wonders how exactly any of this came to happen.
As she sets off to start collecting tinder—dried palm leaves, shavings from the trees, what grasses she thinks might help—Loot bounds up onto her shoulders, chirping enthusiastically.

claims.summary: By episode 5, Loot travels with Chandra.

claims.subject: mahitab

evidence.quote: Mahitab found Niharet and freed her, but the girl Mahitab had grown up with, the girl she'd loved, was never the same again.

claims.summary: Mahitab freed Niharet after she was entombed.

remaining: Episodes 3 and 4, 'Like No Other Beast' and guide part 2 are not cited
The unnamed 'man in blue' on Tarkir in the final scene is not identified
Sita/Spitfire, her father's coup attempt and Elspeth's role in stopping it are not graded
